issues.title: Density-limit entropy remainder is too strong
issues.analysis: Only k(n)/n→p is assumed. For p=1/4 and k=floor(n/4+sqrt(n)), differentiability of entropy gives nH(k/n)-nH(p)=log2(3)*sqrt(n)+O(1), exceeding logarithmic error. The exponential classification survives.
issues.suggested_fix: Use nH2(k(n)/n)+O(log n)=nH2(p)+o(n), with the uniform Stirling argument.

issues.title: Schur state record is not unique at zero weight
issues.quote: if and only if it can be written uniquely as
issues.analysis: A normalized density block attached to p_lambda=0 is unconstrained by the represented state. Unnormalized blocks are unique.
issues.suggested_fix: State uniqueness for weights and unnormalized blocks; omit normalized blocks of zero weight.

issues.title: Trajectory confinement does not imply gatewise subspace invariance
issues.quote: Use the weight sectors as packet nodes and apply \cref{cor:packet-graph-collapse}.
issues.analysis: Bounded-excitation corollary assumes confinement of the actual trajectory, while the graph corollary requires all active sector inputs to stay in the sector union. The conclusion is valid directly by inserting P on the actual trajectory.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace that application with PG_tP psi_(t-1)=G_t psi_(t-1), and require efficient initialization.

issues.title: Numerical reconstruction mislabeled as exact computation
issues.analysis: validate.py uses NumPy complex128 and tolerance 2e-12. Structural exactness of the mathematical subspace is distinct from exact arithmetic.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename recorded panels; distinguish integer checks, new rational controls, numerical diagnostics, and historical timings.

issues.title: Small nonzero leakage silently accepted by exact packet compiler
issues.analysis: Nonzero off-packet coefficients below squared threshold are dropped while method claims to reject leakage. A one-qubit rotation of size 1e-7 in a fixed-weight packet demonstrates it. Squared magnitudes can also underflow.
issues.suggested_fix: Reject based on any nonzero represented off-packet coefficient, separately retaining magnitude as diagnostic.

issues.title: Complex gates cannot update a real input array
issues.analysis: A real input state with imaginary diagonal gate causes an unsafe complex-to-real accumulation. It must promote the output dtype.
issues.suggested_fix: Promote to result_type(state,gate,complex128) and exercise control.

issues.title: Finite unitary invariance described as weaker than commutation
issues.quote: The equation is slightly more general than commutation: it requires invariance of the selected subspace, not necessarily invariance of its orthogonal complement.
issues.analysis: For finite-dimensional unitary G, invariant S maps onto itself and S-perp is invariant, hence G commutes with P. The weaker relation holds for general linear maps.
issues.suggested_fix: State distinction between general maps and finite-dimensional unitaries.

issues.title: Algorithmic access hypotheses need explicit initialization and enumeration
issues.analysis: Knowing each transition probability is efficient is not an algorithm for enumerating successors or identifying equivalent histories. Several simulation corollaries similarly left initialization implicit.
issues.suggested_fix: Require polynomial enumeration, canonical state keys sufficient for future evolution, initialization, numerical precision and appropriate output support; make shared initialization hypotheses explicit.
